verses.original: הַה֡וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָה֩ הַקָּשָׁ֜ה וְהַגְּדוֹלָ֣ה וְהַֽחֲזָקָ֗ה בְּחַרְב֨וֹ יִפְקֹ֣ד עַ֤ל לִוְיָתָן֙ בָּרִ֔חַ וְעַל֙ נָחָ֣שׁ לִוְיָתָ֔ן עֲקַלָּת֑וֹן נָחָ֖שׁ וְהָרַ֥ג אֶת־ הַתַּנִּ֖ין אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּיָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh haq·qā·šāh wə·hag·gə·ḏō·w·lāh wə·ha·ḥă·zā·qāh bə·ḥar·ḇō yip̄·qōḏ ‘al liw·yā·ṯān bā·ri·aḥ wə·‘al nā·ḥāš liw·yā·ṯān ‘ă·qal·lā·ṯō·wn nā·ḥāš wə·hā·raḡ ’eṯ- hat·tan·nîn ’ă·šer bay·yām
verses.literal: In that day the LORD [will take] His sharp great and mighty sword and bring judgment on Leviathan the fleeing . . . serpent Leviathan the coiling serpent and He will slay - the dragon - of the sea

verses.original: הַה֑וּא בַּיּ֖וֹם עַנּוּ־ לָֽהּ׃ חֶ֖מֶד כֶּ֥רֶם
verses.literal: In that day Sing about a fruitful vineyard

verses.original: אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ נֹֽצְרָ֔הּ אַשְׁקֶ֑נָּה לִרְגָעִ֖ים אֶצֳּרֶֽנָּה׃ לַ֥יְלָה וָי֖וֹם פֶּ֚ן יִפְקֹ֣ד עָלֶ֔יהָ
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî Yah·weh nō·ṣə·rāh ’aš·qen·nāh lir·ḡā·‘îm ’eṣ·ṣo·ren·nāh lay·lāh wā·yō·wm pen yip̄·qōḏ ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: I the LORD am its keeper I water it continually . . . I guard it night and day so no one can disturb it

verses.original: אֵ֣ין לִ֑י מִֽי־ חֵמָ֖ה שַׁ֙יִת֙ שָׁמִ֥יר יִתְּנֵ֜נִי בַּמִּלְחָמָ֔ה אֶפְשְׂעָ֥ה בָ֖הּ אֲצִיתֶ֥נָּה יָּֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên lî mî- ḥê·māh ša·yiṯ šā·mîr yit·tə·nê·nî bam·mil·ḥā·māh ’ep̄·śə·‘āh ḇāh ’ă·ṣî·ṯen·nāh yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: I am not - angry If only thorns and briers confronted Me I would march and trample them I would burn them to the ground

verses.original: א֚וֹ יַחֲזֵ֣ק בְּמָעוּזִּ֔י יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה שָׁל֖וֹם לִ֑י יַֽעֲשֶׂה־ שָׁל֖וֹם לִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ya·ḥă·zêq bə·mā·‘ūz·zî ya·‘ă·śeh šā·lō·wm lî ya·‘ă·śeh- šā·lō·wm lî
verses.literal: Or let them lay claim to My protection let them make peace with Me [yes,] let them make peace with Me

verses.original: הַבָּאִים֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב יַשְׁרֵ֣שׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּפָרַ֖ח יָצִ֥יץ וּמָלְא֥וּ פְנֵי־ תֵבֵ֖ל תְּנוּבָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: hab·bā·’îm ya·‘ă·qōḇ yaš·rêš yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ā·raḥ yā·ṣîṣ ū·mā·lə·’ū p̄ə·nê- ṯê·ḇêl tə·nū·ḇāh
verses.literal: In the days to come Jacob will take root Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world . . . with fruit

verses.original: מַכֵּ֖הוּ הַכְּמַכַּ֥ת הִכָּ֑הוּ אִם־ הֲרֻגָ֖יו כְּהֶ֥רֶג הֹרָֽג׃
verses.transliteration: mak·kê·hū hak·kə·mak·kaṯ hik·kā·hū ’im- hă·ru·ḡāw kə·he·reḡ hō·rāḡ
verses.literal: Has the LORD struck Israel as He struck her oppressors . . . Was she killed like those who slayed her . . .

verses.original: בְּסַּאסְּאָ֖ה בְּשַׁלְחָ֣הּ תְּרִיבֶ֑נָּה הָגָ֛ה הַקָּשָׁ֖ה בְּרוּח֥וֹ בְּי֥וֹם קָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bə·sas·sə·’āh bə·šal·ḥāh tə·rî·ḇen·nāh hā·ḡāh haq·qā·šāh bə·rū·ḥōw bə·yō·wm qā·ḏîm
verses.literal: By warfare and exile You contended with her and removed her with a fierce wind as on the day the east wind [blows]

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן בְּזֹאת֙ יַעֲקֹ֔ב עֲוֺֽן־ יְכֻפַּ֣ר כָּל־ פְּרִ֖י הָסִ֣ר חַטָּאת֑וֹ וְזֶ֕ה בְּשׂוּמ֣וֹ׀ כָּל־ מִזְבֵּ֗חַ כְּאַבְנֵי־ אַבְנֵ֣י מְנֻפָּצ֔וֹת גִר֙ לֹֽא־ אֲשֵׁרִ֖ים וְחַמָּנִֽים׃ יָקֻ֥מוּ
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên bə·zōṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ ‘ă·wōn- yə·ḵup·par kāl- pə·rî hā·sir ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·zeh bə·śū·mōw kāl- miz·bê·aḥ kə·’aḇ·nê- ’aḇ·nê mə·nup·pā·ṣō·wṯ ḡir lō- ’ă·šê·rîm wə·ḥam·mā·nîm yā·qu·mū
verses.literal: Therefore . . . Jacob’s guilt will be atoned for and the full fruit of the removal of his sin will be this When he makes all the altar . . . stones like crushed bits of chalk no Asherah poles or incense altars will remain standing

verses.original: כִּ֣י בְּצוּרָה֙ עִ֤יר בָּדָ֔ד נָוֶ֕ה מְשֻׁלָּ֥ח כַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וְנֶעֱזָ֖ב שָׁ֣ם עֵ֛גֶל יִרְעֶ֥ה וְשָׁ֥ם יִרְבָּ֖ץ וְכִלָּ֥ה סְעִפֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·ṣū·rāh ‘îr bā·ḏāḏ nā·weh mə·šul·lāḥ kam·miḏ·bār wə·ne·‘ĕ·zāḇ šām ‘ê·ḡel yir·‘eh wə·šām yir·bāṣ wə·ḵil·lāh sə·‘i·p̄e·hā
verses.literal: For the fortified city lies deserted a homestead abandoned a wilderness forsaken There the calves graze and there they lie down they strip its branches {bare}

verses.original: קְצִירָהּ֙ בִּיבֹ֤שׁ תִּשָּׁבַ֔רְנָה נָשִׁ֕ים בָּא֖וֹת מְאִיר֣וֹת אוֹתָ֑הּ כִּ֣י ה֔וּא עַם־ לֹ֤א בִּינוֹת֙ עַל־ כֵּן֙ עֹשֵׂ֔הוּ לֹֽא־ יְרַחֲמֶ֣נּוּ וְיֹצְר֖וֹ לֹ֥א יְחֻנֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: qə·ṣî·rāh bî·ḇōš tiš·šā·ḇar·nāh nā·šîm bā·’ō·wṯ mə·’î·rō·wṯ ’ō·w·ṯāh kî hū ‘am- lō bî·nō·wṯ ‘al- kên ‘ō·śê·hū lō- yə·ra·ḥă·men·nū wə·yō·ṣə·rōw lō yə·ḥun·nen·nū
verses.literal: When its limbs are dry they are broken off Women come and use them for kindling - for this [is] a people without understanding Therefore . . . their Maker has no compassion on them and their Creator shows them no favor

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם יְהוָ֛ה יַחְבֹּ֧ט מִשִּׁבֹּ֥לֶת הַנָּהָ֖ר עַד־ נַ֣חַל מִצְרָ֑יִם וְאַתֶּ֧ם בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס תְּלֻקְּט֛וּ לְאַחַ֥ד אֶחָ֖ד
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm Yah·weh yaḥ·bōṭ miš·šib·bō·leṯ han·nā·hār ‘aḏ- na·ḥal miṣ·rā·yim wə·’at·tem bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl tə·luq·qə·ṭū lə·’a·ḥaḏ ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: - In that day the LORD will thresh from the flowing Euphrates to the Wadi of Egypt and you O Israelites . . . will be gathered one by one

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ הַה֗וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם גָּדוֹל֒ בְּשׁוֹפָ֣ר יִתָּקַע֮ הָאֹֽבְדִים֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ אַשּׁ֔וּר וּבָ֗אוּ וְהַנִּדָּחִ֖ים בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם וְהִשְׁתַּחֲו֧וּ לַיהוָ֛ה הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ בְּהַ֥ר בִּירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ha·hū bay·yō·wm gā·ḏō·wl bə·šō·w·p̄ār yit·tā·qa‘ hā·’ō·ḇə·ḏîm bə·’e·reṣ ’aš·šūr ū·ḇā·’ū wə·han·nid·dā·ḥîm bə·’e·reṣ miṣ·rā·yim wə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wū Yah·weh haq·qō·ḏeš bə·har bî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And in that day a great ram’s horn will sound and those who were perishing vvv in Assyria will come forth with those who were exiles vvv in Egypt And they will worship the LORD on the holy mountain in Jerusalem
